glosses: employee (person who works, together with others, in a particular business or institution)
collaborator (person who works with others towards a common goal)
assistant (person who assists another person in a business)

examples.en: I know a man you work with.

examples.text: Die meisten unserer Mitarbeiter sind jung.
examples.en: Most of our employees are young.

examples.text: Einige unserer Mitarbeiter arbeiten von zu Hause.
examples.en: Some of our employees work from home.
